tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_elder:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.
Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight_bio:
After years on the trail of a legendary Eldwurm, the Knight Davion found himself facing a disappointing foe: the dreaded Slyrak had grown ancient and frail, its wings tattered, its few remaining scales stricken with scale-rot, its fangs ground to nubs, and its fire-gouts no more threatening than a pack of wet matchsticks.

Seeing no honor to be gained in dragon-murder, Knight Davion prepared to turn away and leave his old foe to die in peace. But a voice crept into his thoughts, and Slyrak gave a whispered plea that Davion might honor him with death in combat. Davion agreed, and found himself rewarded beyond expectation for his act of mercy: As he sank his blade in Slyrak's breast, the dragon pierced Davion's throat with a talon. As their blood mingled, Slyrak sent his power out along the Blood Route, sending all its strength and centuries of wisdom to the knight. The dragon's death sealed their bond and Dragon Knight was born. The ancient power slumbers in the Dragon Knight Davion, waking when he calls it. Or perhaps it is the Dragon that calls the Knight...
tokens.npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight_hype: When he takes on his terrifying dragon form, Dragon Knight strikes fear into any who face him. Strong and adaptable, he can stun his enemies and burn all in front of him, often providing his allies the momentum they need to carry them to victory.

* Has the following targeting functionalities:

**** {{Code|OP {{=}} FirstRadius}}
**** {{Code|PQ {{=}} TravelDistance}}

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The {{M|Transformation Ability|text=transformation}} is instantaneous and does not persist {{M|death}}.

* Grants the following bonuses upon cast:
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|dragon_knight_dragon_form}}
*** Recasting the ability refreshes the duration and adapts the ability values correspondingly.
*** {{Symbol|bonus atk}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Ranged}}
**** Davion is now a [[ranged]] hero in Elder Dragon Form with a {{#var:Elder Dragon Form value2}}-attack {{M|projectile speed}}.
***** Does not affect [[attack range]] manipulating sources.
***** Items that use different values for the wielder's attack range-type now considers Davion as a ranged unit.
*** {{A|Dragon Knight|Dragon Tail}}
**** Has an increased cast range and uses a projectile.
*** {{A|Dragon Knight|Wyrm's Wrath}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Attack Modifier}}
**** All attack modifiers are multiplied according to the Elder Dragon Form factor accordingly.
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} Has {{M|unobstructed movement}}.
**** Acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} immediately grants unobstructed movement and increases the bonus {{A|Dragon Knight|Wyrm's Wrath}} ability values, but does not update the ability values of the current instance.

* {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Splash}} {{Symbol|Target|Area-Dummy}}
** [[Splash]] attack is applied as {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} within the radius upon a successful attack centered around the affected enemy unit [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] , and has the following properties:
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** The damage value is affected by the following sources on the enemy unit:
***** {{M|Damage block}} sources.
***** {{M|Incoming damage|text=incoming|t=n}} {{M|spell damage|x}} amplification sources.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** The primary target.
***** {{M|Buildings}}
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
**** Not affected by the following sources on Davion:
***** {{M|Outgoing damage|text=Outgoing|t=p}} {{M|spell damage}} amplification sources.
***** {{M|Spell lifesteal}} sources.

* {{Symbol|Attack Modifier}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The [[attack modifier]] effects are applied as follows:
**# The {{M|splash}} damage instances on secondary targets.
**# Davion's attack instance on the primary target.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight
data.bio_loc:
After years on the trail of a legendary Eldwurm, the Knight Davion found himself facing a disappointing foe: the dreaded Slyrak had grown ancient and frail, its wings tattered, its few remaining scales stricken with scale-rot, its fangs ground to nubs, and its fire-gouts no more threatening than a pack of wet matchsticks.

Seeing no honor to be gained in dragon-murder, Knight Davion prepared to turn away and leave his old foe to die in peace. But a voice crept into his thoughts, and Slyrak gave a whispered plea that Davion might honor him with death in combat. Davion agreed, and found himself rewarded beyond expectation for his act of mercy: As he sank his blade in Slyrak's breast, the dragon pierced Davion's throat with a talon. As their blood mingled, Slyrak sent his power out along the Blood Route, sending all its strength and centuries of wisdom to the knight. The dragon's death sealed their bond and Dragon Knight was born. The ancient power slumbers in the Dragon Knight Davion, waking when he calls it. Or perhaps it is the Dragon that calls the Knight...
data.hype_loc: When he takes on his terrifying dragon form, Dragon Knight strikes fear into any who face him. Strong and adaptable, he can stun his enemies and burn all in front of him, often providing his allies the momentum they need to carry them to victory.
data.npe_desc_loc: Transforms into a formidable ranged dragon

abilities.name: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
abilities.desc_loc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
abilities.lore_loc: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_dragon_tail
abilities.desc_loc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
abilities.lore_loc: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
abilities.desc_loc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
abilities.lore_loc: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_fireball
abilities.desc_loc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
abilities.lore_loc: Most Dragon Knights name no greater horror than the scourge of dragon's fire.

facets_loc: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
abilities.desc_loc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
abilities.lore_loc: The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
